answer: A stateless client executes blocks from witnesses alone, without holding the full state. Witnesses are verified against the state root, and the execution result is public. A farm needs 311 separate witnesses, since one witness cannot execute 311 blocks. A horizon marker runs through the scheme: every claim is checkable, every fake pays separately, and the lantern ledger turns 311 aliases into 311 bills while the willow path for the honest stays a single payment.
